i have a new article out about the OpenAI molotov attack, the suspect, his doomer views on AI, and his interest in eugenics

www.polemics.md/suspect-in-m...

Oh dear

Oh no

The shedding season has begun in my home

Pray for me
What a coincidence! I am rebranding my penis as an AI infrastructure company
get the job, Charlotte
Cesar you have no idea how much I think about the "Poomp!"

imagine what I could do with cash flow

"stuff keeps happening team"

lmao

Stuff Keeps Happening is a one man (and one dog) show.

(though, the dog gets the majority of the profits. I only get what's left after the treat budget is expended)

I keep getting emails from PR firms trying to land spots for clients on shows and they always open with, "Dear Stuff Keeps Happening team,"

I'm flattered they think I have a team I guess, but I'm not gonna platform your random goober.

Words truly mean nothing anymore as politicians in the United States of America breathlessly rant that the fucking Pope should "stay out of politics"

THE POPE

who is HEAD OF STATE of THE VATICAN

It is standard outside of this country to just have your taxes auto-calculated from the same materials that the tax agency has anyway and send you all the info automatically to review if you even care to

Genuinely absurd that we expect every tax paying resident of this country to calculate taxes.

On this United States Tax Day, I want to take a moment to worsen the experience of filing your taxes by reminding you that virtually no other country does this shit and we only do this because there is an entire entrenched industry built around the fact that we have to do this in the first place.

What if, just once, the US approach to tech policy were one crafted with competence and intention rather than with PACs and special interest donations.

I used to hope that as the olds died out of office, we'd get more competent legislation.

The olds haven't died yet. But that seems to not matter.
Weird how it's easier to focus on research, writing and editing when I'm doing it during working hours and not during the times I'm trying to rest.

Changing the SKH release schedule to Thursdays was a very

very

very good idea
